academy.developer.desc.brain_course: Train your brain to sustain abilities longer. Increases maximum CP by 1,000.
academy.developer.desc.brain_course_adva: Undertake advanced mental development to sustain abilities longer and withstand more overload. Increases maximum CP by 1,000 and maximum overload by 100.
academy.developer.desc.mind_course: Learn to relax your mind more effectively, increasing CP recovery speed by 20%%.
academy.developer.desc.arc_gen: Generate a weak electric arc that damages the area around its impact. A direct hit can ignite flammable blocks.
academy.developer.desc.mag_manip: Pull, move, and throw magnetizable blocks with magnetic force. A thrown block is placed where it lands and damages enemies it strikes.
academy.developer.desc.mine_detect: Sense nearby magnetic fields to reveal valuable ores, even through walls.
academy.developer.desc.railgun: Use electromagnetic induction to launch a coin at extreme speed, dealing devastating damage on impact.
academy.developer.desc.mag_movement: Create a strong magnetic field that pulls you toward a targeted magnetic block, making it useful for movement and escape.
academy.developer.desc.iron_sand: Separate and manipulate iron sand to create versatile, dangerous attacks.
academy.developer.desc.charging: Generate electric current to charge the held item or compatible energy blocks in the world.
academy.developer.desc.body_intensify: Toggle: after a warm-up, gain random buffs that grow in number and strength with proficiency (all five at 100%%; Jump and Resistance cap at II). Drains CP and food while on.
academy.developer.desc.thunder_clap: Manipulate the atmospheric electromagnetic field to form thunderclouds and call down a devastating lightning strike.
academy.developer.desc.thunder_bolt: Compress a vast amount of electricity into a powerful bolt. On hitting an entity, the current bursts outward and deals secondary damage nearby.
academy.developer.desc.threatening_telep: Teleport the item in your hand to a point ahead. Overlapping it with an enemy can deal severe damage.
academy.developer.desc.dim_folding_theor: Exploit unstable spatial folds during teleportation to make teleport-based attacks split unpredictably and deal more damage.
academy.developer.desc.penetrate_telepor: Estimate the thickness of the obstacle ahead and teleport straight through it.
academy.developer.desc.mark_teleport: Mark a target in your line of sight as your destination, then teleport to it.
academy.developer.desc.flesh_ripping: Lock onto a living target and teleport part of its flesh outside its body, dealing severe damage and potentially causing nausea.
academy.developer.desc.location_teleport: Record your current coordinates and later teleport back from long range. Nearby entities can be carried along at a high CP cost.
academy.developer.desc.shift_tp: Teleport the block in your hand along a coordinate-defined path and place it at the destination. The spatial fold damages entities in its path.
academy.developer.desc.space_fluct: Amplify spatial fluctuations so teleport-based attacks split more strongly and deal greater damage.
academy.developer.desc.flashing: Chain multiple teleports in a short time to maneuver freely through the air.
academy.developer.desc.electron_bomb: Gather a small cluster of electrons and release a destructive beam after a brief delay.
academy.developer.desc.rad_intensify: The beta radiation carried by the high-speed electron beam weakens hit targets, causing them to take more damage for a short time.
academy.developer.desc.ray_barrage: Fire a high-energy beam into a Silicon Barn to scatter it into a barrage that sweeps the area ahead.
academy.developer.desc.scatter_bomb: Control several electron clusters at once and release them as an attack. The increased number comes at the cost of accuracy.
academy.developer.desc.meltdowner: Fire an extremely high-energy electron beam capable of melting walls and metal. At high output, its power and instability can also injure you.
academy.developer.desc.light_shield: Spread a cluster of high-speed electrons into a shield that destroys incoming matter and damages anything that comes too close.
academy.developer.desc.jet_engine: Expel electrons like a rocket engine and use the reaction force for rapid movement. A temporary Light Shield protects you during the dash.
academy.developer.desc.mine_ray_basic: Refine your electron beam so it can harvest targeted blocks without destroying their resources.
academy.developer.desc.mine_ray_expert: Improve your control over the beam to harvest blocks and resources more efficiently.
academy.developer.desc.mine_ray_luck: After extensive practice, you can extract extra resources from ores more reliably.
academy.developer.desc.electron_missile: Maintain a large cloud of electrons and fire portions of it as powerful projectiles.
academy.developer.desc.dir_shock: Redirect the reaction force from a punch into the target, increasing the impact.
academy.developer.desc.ground_shock: Stomp the ground and redirect the resulting force forward. The shock breaks terrain and launches entities it hits.
academy.developer.desc.vec_accel: Redirect the force of your step forward to accelerate yourself rapidly.
academy.developer.desc.vec_deviation: Remove the velocity of incoming projectiles so they fall, and reduce some melee damage.
academy.developer.desc.dir_blast: Multiply the reaction force of a punch and direct it forward for a devastating blow. Direct hits can break blocks.
academy.developer.desc.storm_wing: Manipulate air vectors to form four small whirlwinds behind you and fly with their thrust. At low proficiency, they can break nearby blocks.
academy.developer.desc.blood_retro: Reverse an enemy's blood flow, rupturing major vessels and dealing lethal damage.
academy.developer.desc.vec_reflection: Reverse dangerous incoming vectors toward your line of sight, turning the attack back on your opponent.
academy.developer.desc.plasma_cannon: Manipulate and compress a large volume of air into a massive plasma body, then launch it forward.
